DECISIVE_regime_split.discipline: E-0907-A: the reference window must match the live regime
DECISIVE_regime_split.reading: The entire measured hedge is a 2022-2024 phenomenon. On the regime-matched FROZEN window the unconditional rho is statistically zero and the conditional PAYOFF is zero (+0.958 CI [-11.39, +13.58]) even though the conditional rho is still -0.286 -- which is the trap: rho measures co-movement, not payoff. In 2026 the sign has flipped with confidence: rho +0.1848 CI [+0.113, +0.256] and TSMOM LOSES -16.484 CI [-25.28, -8.19] inside A0's bottom quintile. This is the Amihud failure mode arriving one regime later.
DECISIVE_regime_split.label: VERIFIED
